scope: Quasi-static self-weight over the listed finite ROM scans and named/coordinated cases. Same-frame solid overlaps and full bearing envelopes overcount mass. No actual measurement, impact, fatigue, lifetime or complete continuous-configuration proof. Screw torque is intentionally not inferred from clamp force.
assumptions: Friction coefficient >=0.08 must be measured for the selected dry steel washer pair. Brake pads are specified as flat cold-rolled 304 washers, minimum yield 230 MPa; compressive allowable 115 MPa. Spherical wrist liners retain their separate S1 material assumption.
Custom shafts require certified minimum yield 750 MPa after machining; lumbar flexion requires 940 MPa. Ordinary annealed 304 rods do not meet these requirements.
Printed allowable 8 MPa and modulus 1500 MPa are design assumptions, not filament qualification.
Metal plates specified cold-rolled 304 minimum yield 230 MPa; spring-pin strength applies only to the referenced grade/specification.
